response.message: Rank 12: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood - After a horrific alchemy experiment goes wrong in the Elric household, brothers Edward and Alphonse are left in a terrible situation. In a desperate attempt to bring their mother back to life, they lose parts of their bodies and are forced to pay a heavy toll. Now, the brothers set out on a journey to find the Philosopher's Stone and restore their bodies, uncovering a vast conspiracy along the way.
